title: Feels Like Yesterday
blurb: Apps, hits, memes and money from 2000 to 2025, scrambled with history until time breaks.

cards.say: [Roblox came out before the first iPhone], [Spotify launched after the first iPhone], [Netflix was founded before Google], and [Minecraft came out before the first iPhone].
cards.real: Minecraft first went public in 2009, two years after the iPhone. Roblox beat the iPhone by almost a year, launching in 2006.

cards.say: [Google's search engine was first called BackRub], [Instagram started out as an app called Picaboo], [Amazon was first incorporated under the name Cadabra], and [Bluetooth is named after a Danish king from the 900s].
cards.real: Picaboo was Snapchat's first name. Instagram grew out of an earlier app called Burbn.

cards.say: [Billie Eilish swept the four biggest Grammys at age 18], [in 2019, Old Town Road broke the record for most weeks at number one], [Gangnam Style hit number one on the Billboard Hot 100], and [Apple's iTunes Store opened in 2003 selling songs for 99 cents].
cards.real: Gangnam Style peaked at number two on the Hot 100 in 2012, though it did become the first YouTube video to pass a billion views.

cards.say: [Amazon was the first U.S. company to be worth a trillion dollars], [Google bought YouTube for 1.65 billion dollars in 2006], [a man paid 10,000 bitcoin for two pizzas in 2010], and [in 1997, Microsoft invested 150 million dollars to help save Apple].
cards.real: Apple got there first, on August 2, 2018. Amazon briefly touched the mark about a month later.

cards.say: [Shrek won the first ever Oscar for Best Animated Feature], [Up was the first animated movie nominated for Best Picture], [Parasite was the first non-English-language film to win Best Picture], and [Steve Jobs owned most of Pixar when Toy Story came out].
cards.real: Disney's Beauty and the Beast, from 1991, was the first animated film nominated for Best Picture, nearly two decades before Up.

cards.say: [the word meme was coined in a 1976 book about genes], [Keyboard Cat was filmed in 1984, decades before it went viral], [the Rickroll song came out in 1987, 20 years before Rickrolling], and [the first emoji were designed by Apple for the iPhone in 2008].
cards.real: Emoji started in Japan in the late 1990s. Shigetaka Kurita's early set from 1999 is now in New York's Museum of Modern Art.

cards.say: [LeBron James played a year of college ball before the NBA], [Leicester City won the Premier League in 2016 at odds of 5,000 to 1], [the Chicago Cubs went 108 years between World Series titles], and [in 2024, Shohei Ohtani became MLB's first 50-homer, 50-steal player].
cards.real: LeBron went straight from high school in Akron, Ohio, to the NBA as the first pick of the 2003 draft.

cards.say: [the first iPhone couldn't copy and paste], [Gmail launched on April Fools' Day in 2004], [Twitter's founders invented the hashtag in 2007], and [Facebook went five years without a like button].
cards.real: The hashtag was suggested in 2007 by a Twitter user, Chris Messina. Twitter didn't start linking hashtags until 2009.

cards.say: [Toyota started out as a company that made motorcycles], [Nokia started out in 1865 as a mill making wood pulp], [Samsung began in 1938 selling dried fish and groceries], and [Lamborghini built farm tractors before it ever built a sports car].
cards.real: Toyota grew out of Toyoda Automatic Loom Works, a company that made weaving machines. Its car business started in the 1930s.

cards.say: [NASA's Mars helicopter carried a scrap of fabric from the Wright brothers' plane], [the first photo of a black hole was released in 2019], [Voyager 1 reached interstellar space before YouTube was founded], and [the James Webb Space Telescope launched on Christmas Day 2021].
cards.real: Voyager 1 crossed into interstellar space in August 2012, seven years after YouTube launched in 2005.

cards.say: [Tetris was created by a computer scientist in the Soviet Union], [Mario was called Jumpman when he debuted in 1981's Donkey Kong], [Sony's PlayStation started out as a joint project with Nintendo], and [Apple banned Flappy Bird in 2014 for being too addictive].
cards.real: Flappy Bird's creator, Dong Nguyen, pulled the game himself in 2014, saying it had become too addictive.

cards.say: [Nike paid a college student 35 dollars to design its swoosh], [Crocs were first sold in 2002 as a comfy shoe for nurses], [Dogecoin was created in 2013 as a joke making fun of crypto], and [the QR code was invented in 1994 to keep track of car parts].
cards.real: Crocs debuted in 2002 at a boat show in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, where all 200 pairs sold out.
